gates.criterion: Preserve pauses/shallow excursions, prevent invented flat-signal strokes and amplitude expansion, retain timestamp/identity/reacquisition boundaries.

gates.criterion: Source-matched target/view annotations, checked script alignment, curated category coverage and independent held-out scoring.

gates.criterion: Shared GUI/CLI/batch/live motion semantics, neutral six-axis master, timestamp/clock provenance, source/candidate identity and explicit uncertainty.

gates.criterion: Protected edits, explicit unlock/replacement, candidate review/commit, rebase, undo/redo and restart preservation.

gates.criterion: Revision-bound native project migration, per-axis result/partial status, standard funscript export, archival exact receipt recovery and Stash publication without replacing existing work.

This does not select useful default models, establish quality/speed floors, cover other input families or qualify GPU vendors. Rebenchmark permitted candidates before targeted fitting.

gates.criterion: Local structured target/settings/review/edit proposals, current owner/project/revision binding, separate approval and protected undoable effects.

gates.criterion: Neutral six-axis outputs, VR/stereo/projection handling, explicit per-channel lineage, observability and limitations.

gates.criterion: MOT-02 through MOT-05: neutral master preserved, timing preserved, amplitude/dynamics/coupled-axis limits enforced and inability disclosed.

gates.criterion: Core includes all baseline Fast input families, local assistant, editing/export and offline playback. Complete is the default full-offline edition and includes every advertised installed tier.

gates.criterion: Windows single executable, Linux AppImage, Apple Silicon macOS support and proposed app/dmg packaging; genuine qualified NVIDIA/AMD/Apple/Intel acceleration for every tier.

gates.criterion: 16 GB system floor; qualified per-tier RAM/VRAM, startup and response deadlines; avoid unified-memory double counting.

gates.criterion: Per-category Default stroke precision and recall at least 80%, target 90%; material-error flag recall at least 95% against independent annotations.

gates.criterion: Required Fast stroke-only paths >1x realtime; reference GPU Fast at least 10x. CPU Default at least 0.5x, reference GPU Default at least 5x.

gates.next_proof: Measure complete decode-to-export performance on the specified 30-minute reference workload and exact hardware.

gates.criterion: Measured human correction effort, applicable test matrix, explicit experimental labels for unqualified six-axis playback and actual preview artifacts.
gates.previous_boundary: The five-human-hour annotation pilot is a method trial, not release coverage. Required regression, native, storage/platform, media/device and human/release gates remain independent.
gates.next_proof: Complete the applicable Preview test matrix and measured human correction protocol with required acceptance.

gates.criterion: Per-category Default precision and recall at least 95%, qualified material-error detection, creative/secondary-axis criteria and physical six-axis behavior.
gates.previous_boundary: No Stable acceptance is established by optimizer fitting, authored fixtures or compiled backends.
gates.next_proof: Meet Stable category and secondary-axis/creative/physical criteria with independent evidence.

gates.criterion: For at least 95% of 30-minute clips per category, no more than five minutes editing and ten minutes total human effort.
gates.previous_boundary: Measure a declared independent human protocol. The 95th-percentile effort agreement does not define the live latency percentile.
gates.next_proof: Measure editing and total human effort on the declared independent category protocol.

gates.criterion: Reproducible exact-source/provider/model/hardware comparisons and SOTA claims only after complete supporting evidence.
gates.previous_boundary: Freeze splits, scoring, preprocessing, artifacts and candidate selection; never use sterile evaluation inputs for training or invent signatures/human acceptance.
gates.next_proof: Freeze reproducible source/model/provider/hardware comparisons before any comparative or SOTA claim.
